findings.text: Migration deletes attributable unsent messages written after upgrade. Node reproduction at a193c2e: A upgrades; unreloaded B running 1a713b8 persists b2 with ownerId=2; A.clearLocalAccountData(1); B reloads: [], expected [b2]. The base revision preserves b2; an in-memory mutation that splits tagged entries on every sweep also preserves it. Migrate entries with valid ownerId even after the version flag; discard only unattributed entries.

Concurrent migration overwrites another account's newer unsent write. Node reproduction at a193c2e: seed legacy B:b1; pause A's migration after reading atalks_unsent_2_5; B completes migration and persists b2; resume A. B's persisted list changes from [b1,b2] to [b1], confirmed after reload. The cached firstRun and read-modify-write are not atomic. Serialize migration with normal writes or use per-message storage keys; cover this interleaving.

U40 suppresses errors when no failed row is visible. Node reproduction using production sendMessage/upsertMessageNode: hold POST in channel 5, navigate to Wiki (activeId remains 5), reject with 503. Output: view=wiki, visibleFailedRows=0, toasts=0, failed=true. Adding a chat-view guard in memory produces one toast; the visible-chat control produces none. Suppress only when the failed row is actually visible, including checking the current view and viewport.

F4 ADDRESSED: actual 42aed7c wiki autosave after upgrade gives B null. F5 original reproduction ADDRESSED: two upgraded tabs preserve B's [b1,b2] at every cleanup interleaving. F6 ADDRESSED: held #fresh followed by #general opens [5]; removing the guard in memory yields [5,7]. Reviewed a193c2e directly: ui-r5-sec passes 18/18. Sequential migration is idempotent; F7/F8 identify additional upgrade paths.

Visual verification remains incomplete: ui-r5-ux passes 4/4 and ui-fx2-r2 passes 13/13 against a193c2e using DOM/CSS checks. The original U1, U30-U36 and U40-U43 viewport/screenshot reproductions were not repeated, so their visual status is unverified here. Repeat those checks in a browser at the reviewed commit.
